_doc: B2 concept materials, recovered VERBATIM from Macar et al.'s released code. The fidelity arm replicates their paradigm, so their words are replication materiel and are not paraphrased, reordered or substituted.

provenance.concepts_source: experiments/01_concept_injection.py:58 (DEFAULT_TEST_CONCEPTS, comment: '50 words from the paper')

extraction_method.rule: concept_vector = act(concept prompt) - mean(act over baseline prompts), at the declared layer, last token
extraction_method.DEVIATION_rule_13: their formatter applies a chat template when the tokenizer has one and falls back to 'User: {msg}\n\nAssistant:' otherwise. Rule 13 forbids chat templates at any stage or site, so we take THEIR OWN fallback, which is also the COMPLETION_TEMPLATE the detection harness already uses. Sanctioned by their design, not invented.
extraction_method.layer: per stage, that stage's A4-selected layer (rule 1); their DEFAULT_LAYER_FRACTION 0.7 is NOT inherited

selection_for_B2.problem: PROPOSAL-g §4-B2 and LOCK-g §3 both register EIGHT concepts and describe them as Macar's. Macar's canonical set is FIFTY. There is no canonical eight to recover, so choosing which eight is a DECISION and not a recovery.
selection_for_B2.code_recommendation: the first eight in their declared order -- deterministic, recoverable from the source by anyone, and involving no cherry-picking
alternatives_not_taken: a seeded random draw from the 50 (declared seed; defensible but reproducible only via our config, not from their source)
a semantic spread chosen by hand (introduces our judgment into replication materiel, which the fidelity arm exists to avoid)
raise n to 50 (changes a registered n; a lock amendment, not a config choice)
selection_for_B2.selection_rule_of_record: the first eight in Macar's declared order AFTER excluding rule-18 collisions with the program's frozen pools. As deterministic and recoverable as the bare first-eight: anyone with their sha, our pools and the committed sweep reproduces it with zero judgment. It bites exactly once -- Dust (#1) is excluded; Trees (#11) and Bread (#49) fall outside the window.
selection_for_B2.rationale_of_record: No demonstrated contamination route into a B2 trial is claimed: trials carry framing plus question only, no task text. The exclusion is the categorical hygiene rule doing prophylactic work, and the cost asymmetry is total -- Treasures is exactly as arbitrary a member of an arbitrary fifty as Dust, so excluding costs nothing measurable while keeping buys nothing but a shorter sentence. Shields first.

ninth_concept.name: evaluative_axis
ninth_concept.note: PROPOSAL-g §4-B2: our own reward-marker as a ninth concept -- the affect-shaped probe. Not from Macar.

hygiene_rule_18.note: word-boundary matches, both directions. Collisions are REPORTED not silently dropped: a concept that also appears in an extraction or test pool is a design-instance call, since removing it would depart from the verbatim replication set.

baseline_decision.rationale: Wool/Clouds/Dogs/Time are never injected, never probed and never identification candidates -- they enter only as the subtracted mean, so a corpus collision opens no lexical route into any B2 measurement. Dropping four would be a real deviation from DEFAULT_BASELINE_WORDS[:100], moving every concept vector, for zero hygiene gain. The trade runs opposite to the concepts: for stimuli hygiene dominates fidelity; for the baseline mean fidelity dominates, because hygiene has nothing to bite.

duplicate_verified.finding: THEIRS, not our transcription. DEFAULT_BASELINE_WORDS is exactly 100 long at sha 5d5d9b4, carries Butterflies twice, and our committed list is byte-identical to theirs[:100] (100 entries, 99 unique). Kept as-is: their method, double-weighted mean and all.
duplicate_verified.effect: Butterflies contributes 2/100 rather than 1/100 to the subtracted baseline mean, in their run as in ours.

injected_trial_allocation.status: declared before any session, per the 2026-08-24 disposition
injected_trial_allocation.rule: the runner already declares one, so it is frozen rather than replaced: valence_core.detection.plan_trials assigns concepts round-robin by trial index over the SORTED nine, and the exact 50/50 injected/control split comes from a seeded permutation. Deterministic given (names, n_trials, seed).
injected_trial_allocation.note: 24 injected over 9 concepts cannot be uniform; the realized counts are recorded here and travel in each run's provenance.

scoring_scope.positive_control: the DPO/Instruct-excludes-0, Base/SFT-includes-0 criterion computes over the EIGHT Macar concepts' trials only
scoring_scope.ninth: the evaluative axis reports as its own per-stage sensitivity line beside, deciding nothing for the replication criterion -- their transition is the positive control, and folding our stimulus into that statistic dilutes the control with materiel they never ran
scoring_scope.axis_identification: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY. The eight score against their word; the axis has no word, and any acceptable-answer set we authored would be our judgment inserted into the DV. Verbatim responses retained, no hit/miss scoring; the affirm/deny channel carries the axis's sensitivity line.
